Implement business logic and application workflows. Work with relational and NoSQL databases. Write optimized database queries and data-access logic. Integrate third-party APIs and external services. Implement authentication, authorization, and security mechanisms. Debug and troubleshoot application and production issues. Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability. Write unit and integration tests. Participate in code reviews and technical discussions. Use Git for source code management. Collaborate with frontend developers, QA, DevOps, and product teams. Participate in Agile/Scrum development processes. Maintain technical documentation where required. Required Skills Strong programming experience with Node.js . Strong knowledge of JavaScript / TypeScript . Experience with Express.js, NestJS, or similar Node.js frameworks . Hands-on experience developing REST APIs .  MongoDB MySQL PostgreSQL Good understanding of database design and query optimization. Experience with Git/version control. Good debugging and problem-solving skills.
